data.title: Speed challenge: which version is newer?
story: Release versions are written like "1.9" and "1.10". Compared as text, "1.9" looks bigger. But 1.10 is newer!
Write a function is_newer(a, b) that returns True if version a is newer than b. Break it up with split(".") and turn each part into a number with int().

explanation: Text is compared character by character, so "1.9" > "1.10" because "9" > "1". Once split and turned into lists of numbers, [1, 10] > [1, 9] gives the right answer.
hints: Try it in the console: what does "1.10".split(".") give?
Turn each part into a number with int() and keep them in a new list.
Two lists of numbers can be compared directly: [1, 10] > [1, 9] is True.
